title: Azure SQL
description: Use Azure SQL Database for relational data in the cloud.

data.text: Azure SQL Database is a managed relational database. Use vCore or DTU purchasing models, configure geo-replication, and integrate with EF Core.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Azure SQL provides managed relational database
data.takeaway: Azure SQL simplifies database management. Choose vCore for predictable performance and configure geo-replication for high availability.
